caption: The drawing depicts a single left shoe viewed from the side, primarily colored in muted brown tones with lighter shading to indicate texture and creases in the material. The shoe has a low profile, rounded toe, and a simple seam running diagonally from the inner arch to the outer edge near the eyelets. There are two eyelets for the shoelace, which is light tan or pale green in color and appears frayed at the ends; the laces are loosely tied, with one end drooping down and the other crossing back and forth above the shoe. The inside lining of the shoe is a light color, possibly pale blue or gray, with a thin reddish-brown trim along the top edge. The sole of the shoe is thin and brown, matching the color scheme of the upper portion. The background is a plain, light beige color. In the lower right corner, the name "GRACE HALPIN." is written in capital letters.
title: Slipper
